query: Consider the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Mutual Customer and Allazo Electronics; Does the document indicate that the Agreement does not grant the Receiving Party any rights to the Confidential Information?
gold:
Nothing contained herein shall grant a license under any patent or other intellectual property right, nor shall this Agreement or any transmission of information constitute any representation or warranty to the Receiving Party with respect to infringement of any intellectual property right of others.
The Disclosing Party shall remain the owner of all Confidential Information it discloses.
rag_answer: Yes. The document indicates that the Agreement does not grant the Receiving Party rights or licenses to the Confidential Information. Section 8 states that “Nothing contained herein shall grant a license under any patent or other intellectual property right,” and Section 9 states that “The Disclosing Party shall remain the owner of all Confidential Information it discloses.”

judge.gold_summary: 协议不授予专利或其他知识产权许可，也不构成对他人知识产权侵权的陈述或保证；披露方保留所有保密信息的所有权。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称协议不授予接收方权利或许可，并引用了不授予专利/知识产权许可的条款以及披露方保留保密信息所有权的条款。
judge.gap: 未明确提及协议或信息传递不构成对他人知识产权侵权的陈述或保证。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标中关于不授予许可和保留所有权的核心要点，能够支持对问题的肯定判断；但遗漏了不侵权保证这一附加要点，因此判定为部分命中。
